name: Search persons
description: Searches all Persons by `name`, `email`, `phone`, `notes` and/or custom fields. This endpoint is a wrapper of `/v1/itemSearch` with a narrower OAuth scope. Found Persons can be filtered by Organization ID. See the Pipedrive API docs [here](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Persons#searchPersons)

configurable_props.name: term
configurable_props.label: Search Term
configurable_props.description: The search term to look for. Minimum 2 characters (or 1 if using exact_match).

configurable_props.name: fields
configurable_props.label: Search Fields
configurable_props.description: An array containing fields to perform the search from. Defaults to all of them.

configurable_props.name: exactMatch
configurable_props.label: Exact Match
configurable_props.description: When enabled, only full exact matches against the given term are returned. It is not case sensitive.

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: Will filter Deals by the provided Organization ID. The upper limit of found Deals associated with the Organization is 2000.

configurable_props.name: includeFields
configurable_props.label: Include Fields
configurable_props.description: Supports including optional fields in the results which are not provided by default.

configurable_props.name: start
configurable_props.label: Pagination Start
configurable_props.description: Pagination start. Note that the pagination is based on main results and does not include related items when using `search_for_related_items` parameter.

configurable_props.name: includeAllCustomFields
configurable_props.label: Include All Custom Fields
configurable_props.description: When enabled, all custom fields will be included in the results
